en.t: Twelve inhabitants of Scillium (near Kasserine, modern-day Tunisia) in North Africa are executed for being Christians. This is the earliest record of Christianity in that part of the world
en.s: The Scillitan Martyrs were a group of early Christians of North Africa executed by the Roman Empire in Carthage, modern Tunisia, on 17 July 180 AD. The group takes its name from the nearby town of Scillium. They are venerated as martyrs in the Catholic and Eastern Orthodox churches. Their executions occurred at the end of a wave of persecution of Christians in the Roman Empire during the reign of Marcus Aurelius in 161–180.

zh.s: 斯基利乌姆殉道者是12名早期北非基督徒，于公元180年7月17日在罗马帝国治下的迦太基（今突尼斯）遭处决。这也是该地区最早的基督教记录。这群人以附近的斯基利乌姆镇命名。他们受到天主教会和东正教会尊崇。处决发生在罗马帝国马可·奥勒留皇帝（161—180年在位）统治期间基督徒遭迫害浪潮的末期。

en.s: The Battle of Nahrawan (Arabic: مَعْرَكَة النَّهْرَوَان, romanized: Ma'rakat an-Nahrawān) was fought between the Kufan forces of the fourth Rashidun caliph Ali ibn Abi Talib and the Kharijites, who were primarily composed of qurra originating from across Iraq, in July 658 CE (Safar 38 AH). The latter were a group of former allies of Ali during the First Fitna.

zh.s: 纳赫拉万战役于公元658年7月（伊斯兰历38年萨法尔月）爆发，交战双方是第四任正统哈里发阿里·伊本·阿比·塔利卜率领的库法军队和哈瓦利吉派。哈瓦利吉派主要由来自伊拉克各地的《古兰经》诵读者（qurra）组成，他们曾是第一次穆斯林内战期间阿里的盟友。

en.t: Damasus II is elected pope, and dies 23 days later
en.s: Pope Damasus II (; died 9 August 1048, born Poppo von Brixen) was the Bishop of Rome and ruler of the Papal States from 17 July 1048 to his death on 9 August that same year. He was the second of the German pontiffs nominated by Emperor Henry III. A native of Bavaria, he was the third German to become pope and had one of the shortest papal reigns.

zh.t: 达玛苏斯二世当选教宗，23天后去世
zh.s: 教宗达玛苏斯二世（本名布雷西亚的波波，卒于1048年8月9日）于1048年7月17日至8月9日担任罗马主教和教宗国统治者。他是亨利三世皇帝提名的第二位德国籍教宗。达玛苏斯二世出生于巴伐利亚，是第三位出任教宗的德国人，其在位时间也极短。

en.s: The Battle of Fraga was a battle of the Spanish Reconquista that took place on 17 July 1134 at Fraga, Aragon, Spain. The battle was fought between the combined forces of King Alfonso the Battler and Viscount Centule VI of Béarn, and a variety of Almoravid forces that had come to the aid of the town of Fraga which was being besieged by Alfonso.

zh.s: 弗拉加战役是西班牙收复失地运动期间的一场战斗，于1134年7月17日在西班牙阿拉贡的弗拉加发生。交战双方是阿方索一世国王和贝阿恩子爵森图尔六世率领的联军，以及前来援助弗拉加城的阿尔摩拉维德军队。当时，阿方索正围攻该城。

en.s: The Battle of Gestilren took place on July 17, 1210. The battle was fought between the exiled King of Sweden Sverker and the ruling King Eric. Sverker had been beaten in the previous Battle of Lena, but had returned with new forces. Sverker was killed in the battle. The exact strength of the armies are unknown. The battle was a victory for the Folkung party of local autonomies against the centralising forces of Catholic monarchy. The party would rule the country until they were defeated at the Battle of Sparrsätra in 1247.

zh.s: 盖斯蒂尔伦战役于1210年7月17日爆发，交战双方是被废黜的瑞典国王斯韦克尔和在位国王埃里克。斯韦克尔此前在莱纳战役中战败，但又率领新军返回，并在此战中阵亡。双方兵力的确切规模不明。主张地方自治的福尔孔党派击败了主张中央集权的天主教君主势力。福尔孔党派此后统治瑞典，直到1247年在斯帕尔斯特拉战役中战败。

en.s: The siege of Seville (July 1247 – November 1248) was a 16-month successful investment during the Reconquista of Seville by forces of Ferdinand III of Castile. Although perhaps eclipsed in geopolitical importance by the rapid capture of Córdoba in 1236, which sent a shockwave through the Muslim world, the siege of Seville was nonetheless the most complex military operation undertaken by Fernando III.

zh.s: 塞维利亚围城战发生于1247年7月至1248年11月，是卡斯蒂利亚国王费迪南三世率军收复塞维利亚的一场围城战，历时16个月并取得成功。1236年迅速攻占科尔多瓦或许在地缘政治上影响更大，曾震动穆斯林世界；尽管如此，塞维利亚围城战仍是费迪南三世发动的最复杂军事行动。

en.s: The Battle of Devina occurred on 17 July 1279 near the small fortress of Devina, close to the modern town of Kotel, Burgas Province, south-eastern Bulgaria. Ivailo of Bulgaria attacked the Byzantine army sent to help his rival for the crown Ivan Asen III.

zh.s: 德维纳战役于1279年7月17日在保加利亚东南部布尔加斯州科泰尔镇附近的德维纳小堡垒附近爆发。保加利亚的伊瓦伊洛袭击了拜占庭军队；这支军队是奉命支援其王位竞争对手伊凡·阿森三世的。

en.s: The naval Battle of Saltes Island or Battle of Saltes (Spanish: Batalla de la Isla Saltés) took place on 17 July 1381, off Saltes Island, between the Crown of Castile and the Kingdom of Portugal during the Third Ferdinand War. The Castilian fleet commanded by Don Fernando Sánchez de Tovar defeated decisively the Portuguese fleet led by João Afonso Telo.

zh.s: 萨尔特斯岛海战又称萨尔特斯海战（西班牙语：Batalla de la Isla Saltés），于1381年7月17日在萨尔特斯岛外海发生，交战双方为卡斯蒂利亚王国和葡萄牙王国，属于第三次费迪南战争的一部分。唐·费尔南多·桑切斯·德·托瓦尔率领的卡斯蒂利亚舰队大败若昂·阿丰索·特洛率领的葡萄牙舰队。

en.s: The Yongle Emperor (2 May 1360 – 12 August 1424), personal name Zhu Di, was the third emperor of the Ming dynasty of China, reigning from 1402 to 1424. He was the fourth son of the Hongwu Emperor, the founder of the dynasty. In 1370, Zhu Di was granted the title of Prince of Yan. By 1380, he had relocated to Beiping (present-day Beijing) and was responsible for protecting the northeastern borderlands.

zh.s: 永乐帝（1360年5月2日—1424年8月12日），名朱棣，是中国明朝第三位皇帝，1402年至1424年在位。他是明朝开国皇帝洪武帝的第四子。1370年，朱棣受封燕王；到1380年，他迁居北平（今北京），负责守卫东北边疆。

en.t: Hundred Years' War: Charles VII of France is crowned the King of France in the Reims Cathedral after a successful campaign by Joan of Arc
en.s: Charles VII (22 February 1403 – 22 July 1461), called the Victorious (French: le Victorieux) or the Well-Served (le Bien-Servi), was King of France from 1422 to his death in 1461. His reign saw the end of the Hundred Years' War and a de facto end of the English claims to the French throne. During the Hundred Years' War, Charles VII inherited the throne of France under desperate circumstances.

zh.t: 百年战争：圣女贞德率军取得胜利后，法国国王查理七世在兰斯大教堂加冕
zh.s: 查理七世（1403年2月22日—1461年7月22日），绰号“胜利者”（法语：le Victorieux）或“受眷顾者”（le Bien-Servi），于1422年至1461年去世期间担任法国国王。他在位期间，百年战争结束，英格兰对法国王位的主张事实上终结。查理七世继承法国王位时，正值百年战争中的危急局势。

en.s: The Battle of Castillon was a battle between the forces of England and France which took place on 17 July 1453 in Gascony near the town of Castillon-sur-Dordogne (later Castillon-la-Bataille). On the day of the battle, the English commander, John Talbot, 1st Earl of Shrewsbury, mistakenly believing that the enemy was retreating, led a relatively small advance force of his army in an attack on a strongly fortified French encampment without waiting for reinforcements.

zh.s: 卡斯蒂永战役是英法两军于1453年7月17日在加斯科涅地区进行的一场战斗，地点在多尔多涅河畔卡斯蒂永镇附近，该镇后来更名为卡斯蒂永拉巴泰耶。战斗当天，英军指挥官、什鲁斯伯里伯爵约翰·塔尔博特误以为敌军正在撤退，未等援军抵达便率领规模较小的先头部队，进攻防守严密的法军营地。

en.s: The Capture of Axel was a military event during the Dutch Revolt and the Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604) in which the town of Axel, defended by the Spanish, was captured by an Anglo-Dutch force led by Sir Philip Sidney, with the garrison being put to the sword. It was also the first feat of Maurice of Nassau.

zh.s: 阿克瑟尔攻占战发生于荷兰起义和英西战争（1585—1604年）期间。由菲利普·西德尼爵士率领的英荷联军攻占了由西班牙军队防守的阿克瑟尔镇，守军尽数被杀。这也是拿骚的莫里斯首次建立战功。

en.s: Battle of Suriagehara (摺上原の戦い, Suriagehara no tatakai) was a battle during the Sengoku period (16th century) of Japan. It was fought at a field called Suriagehara, whose modern location is split between the towns of Inawashiro and Bandai in Fukushima Prefecture.

zh.s: 摺上原之战（日语：摺上原の戦い）是日本战国时代（16世纪）的一场战斗。战场是一片名为摺上原的原野，今分属福岛县猪苗代町和磐梯町。

en.s: The Battle of Braşov (German: Schlacht am Kronstadt; Hungarian: Brassó Csata) was fought on July 17, 1603, between the troops of Wallachia led by Radu Şerban and the Habsburg Empire on one side and the Transylvanian troops led by Mózes Székely on the other side. Mózes Székely was killed on the battlefield, and the Wallachian lord Radu Şerban became ruler of Transylvania for until September 1603, when Giorgio Basta and the imperial commissioners took control of the country in the name of the emperor.

zh.s: 布拉索夫战役（德语：Schlacht am Kronstadt；匈牙利语：Brassó Csata）于1603年7月17日爆发。一方是拉杜·舍尔班率领的瓦拉几亚军队及哈布斯堡帝国军队，另一方是莫伊泽什·塞凯伊率领的特兰西瓦尼亚军队。塞凯伊在战场上阵亡，瓦拉几亚统治者拉杜·舍尔班随后成为特兰西瓦尼亚统治者，直到1603年9月乔治·巴斯塔和帝国专员代表皇帝接管该地。

en.s: The capture of Novgorod occurred during the Time of Troubles, which entailed the Swedish occupation of Novgorod from July 1611 until its return to Russia in 1617 as a result of the Treaty of Stolbovo.

en.s: The action of 17 July 1628 took place during the Anglo-French War (1627–1629). The English force led by the Kirke brothers succeeded in capturing a supply convoy bound for New France, severely impairing that colony's ability to resist attack.

zh.s: 1628年7月17日的战斗发生于英法战争（1627—1629年）期间。基尔克兄弟率领的英军成功截获一支驶往新法兰西的补给船队，严重削弱了该殖民地抵御攻击的能力。

en.t: Battle of Burgstall, Angern and Reindorff
en.s: The attack on Burgstall, Angern, and Reindorff was a Swedish surprise night raid against Liga and Holy Roman Empire troops during the Thirty Years' War, at the villages of Burgstall, Angern, and Reindorff near Wolmirstedt. The attack occurred on the night of July 27–28, 1631 and the resulting action was a Swedish victory that boosted their morale and disrupted Imperial supplies; additionally all three villages were burned and plundered.

zh.t: 布格施塔尔、安根和赖因多夫战役
zh.s: 袭击布格施塔尔、安根和赖因多夫是三十年战争期间瑞典军队发动的一次夜间突袭，目标是沃尔米尔施泰特附近三个村庄中的神圣罗马帝国和天主教联盟军队。袭击发生于1631年7月27日至28日夜间，瑞典获胜，士气因此提升，帝国军补给也遭到破坏；三个村庄均被焚毁和洗劫。

en.s: The Battle of Lälitz (Swedish: Slaget vid Lälitz; Russian: Битва при Лялице) was an engagement fought between Swedish and Russian troops in the village of Lälitz on 17 July 1657. It ended with the Russian troops being repulsed and their commander dying of his wounds sustained during the fighting.

zh.s: 莱利茨战役（瑞典语：Slaget vid Lälitz；俄语：Битва при Лялице）是瑞典军队与俄罗斯军队于1657年7月17日在莱利茨村进行的一次交战。俄军被击退，指挥官也因战斗中受伤而死。

en.t: King George I of Great Britain sails down the River Thames with a barge of 50 musicians, where George Frideric Handel's Water Music is premiered
en.s: The River Thames ( TEMZ), known alternatively in parts as the River Isis, is a river that flows through southern England including London. At 215 miles (346 km), it is the longest river entirely in England and the second-longest in the United Kingdom, after the River Severn. The river rises at Thames Head in Gloucestershire and flows into the North Sea near Tilbury, Essex and Gravesend, Kent, via the Thames Estuary.

zh.t: 英国国王乔治一世乘船沿泰晤士河航行，船上有一支由50名乐师组成的乐队；亨德尔的《水上音乐》首次演出
zh.s: 泰晤士河（读作TEMZ），部分河段也称艾西斯河，流经包括伦敦在内的英格兰南部。全长215英里（346公里），是英格兰境内最长的河流，也是英国第二长河，仅次于塞文河。泰晤士河发源于格洛斯特郡泰晤士河源头，流经泰晤士河口，在埃塞克斯郡蒂尔伯里和肯特郡格雷夫森德附近注入北海。

en.s: The Action of 17 July 1761 was a naval engagement fought off the Spanish port of Cádiz between a British Royal Navy squadron and a smaller French Navy squadron during the Seven Years' War. British fleets had achieved dominance in European waters over the French following heavy defeats of French fleets 1759. To maintain this control, British battle squadrons were stationed off French ports, as well as ports in neutral but French-supporting Spain which sheltered French warships. In 1761, two French ships, the 64-gun ship of the line Achille and 32-gun frigate Bouffone were blockaded in the principal Spanish naval base of Cádiz, on the Southern Atlantic coast of Spain.

zh.s: 1761年7月17日海战是七年战争期间英国皇家海军舰队与规模较小的法国海军舰队在西班牙港口加的斯外海进行的一场海战。1759年法国舰队遭受重创后，英国舰队在欧洲水域取得优势。为维持控制，英国战舰中队驻守在法国港口外，也驻守在中立但支持法国、并庇护法国军舰的西班牙港口外。1761年，两艘法国军舰被封锁在西班牙南大西洋海岸的主要海军基地加的斯：一艘64炮战列舰阿基琉斯号和一艘32炮护卫舰布丰号。

en.t: Former emperor Peter III of Russia is murdered
en.s: Peter III Fyodorovich (Russian: Пётр III Фёдорович, romanized: Pyotr III Fyodorovich, born Charles Peter Ulrich of Schleswig-Holstein-Gottorp; 21 February 1728 – 17 July 1762) was Emperor of Russia from 5 January 1762 until 9 July of the same year, when his wife, Catherine II, overthrew him in a palace coup d'état. He implemented many notable reforms during his reign, though he is criticised for undoing Russian gains in the Seven Years' War by forming an alliance with Prussia.

zh.t: 俄罗斯前皇帝彼得三世遇害
zh.s: 彼得三世·费奥多罗维奇（俄语：Пётр III Фёдорович；转写：Pyotr III Fyodorovich；原名石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因-戈托普的卡尔·彼得·乌尔里希，1728年2月21日—1762年7月17日）于1762年1月5日至同年7月9日担任俄罗斯皇帝，其妻叶卡捷琳娜二世在宫廷政变中推翻了他。他在位期间推行过多项重要改革，但因与普鲁士结盟、放弃俄罗斯在七年战争中的成果而受到批评。

en.s: The Bloody Falls massacre took place during Hudson's Bay Company employee Samuel Hearne's exploration of the Coppermine River for copper deposits near modern-day Kugluktuk, Nunavut, Canada on 17 July 1771. Hearne's original travelogue is now lost, and the narrative that became famous was published after Hearne's death with substantial editorializing.

zh.s: 1771年7月17日，哈德逊湾公司雇员塞缪尔·赫恩在加拿大努纳武特地区、今库格卢克图克附近勘探铜矿时，发生了血瀑布大屠杀。当时他正在探索科珀矿河。赫恩的原始旅行记录现已失传；后来广为人知的叙述是在他去世后发表的，编辑加工成分很大。

en.s: The Champ de Mars massacre took place on 17 July 1791 in Paris at the Champ de Mars against a crowd of republican protesters amid the French Revolution. Two days before, the National Constituent Assembly issued a decree that King Louis XVI would retain his throne under a constitutional monarchy. This decision came after Louis and his family had unsuccessfully tried to flee France in the Flight to Varennes the month before.

zh.s: 战神广场大屠杀于1791年7月17日在巴黎的战神广场发生，目标是聚集在此的共和派示威者。两天前，国民制宪议会颁布法令，决定路易十六国王继续保留王位，实行君主立宪制。此前一个月，路易和王室成员曾在瓦雷讷出逃事件中试图逃离法国，但未能成功。

en.s: The Battle of Perpignan or Battle of Niel (fr:Bataille de Perpignan) on 17 July 1793 saw the French Army of the Eastern Pyrenees led by Louis-Charles de Flers defending against an offensive by the Spanish Army of Catalonia commanded by Antonio Ricardos. The French turned back the Spanish attacks and forced their opponents to pull back.

zh.s: 佩皮尼昂战役又称尼埃尔战役，于1793年7月17日爆发。路易-夏尔·德·弗莱尔率领法国东比利牛斯军团抵御安东尼奥·里卡多斯指挥的西班牙加泰罗尼亚军团进攻。法军击退西班牙军队的攻势，迫使对方撤退。

en.s: The Battle of Trippstadt was a relatively minor French military action in 1794 during the War of the First Coalition. The clash between the French Republican forces and the armies of Prussia and Habsburg Austria was fought over several days (13 to 17 July) in the Palatinate Forest in the German states west of the Rhine River.

zh.s: 特里普施塔特战役是第一次反法同盟战争期间法国于1794年发动的一次规模较小的军事行动。法国共和军与普鲁士、哈布斯堡奥地利军队在普法尔茨森林一带交战，战斗持续数日，从7月13日到17日。该地位于莱茵河以西的德意志诸邦。

en.t: The 16 Carmelite Martyrs of Compiègne are executed ten days prior to the end of the French Revolution's Reign of Terror
en.s: The Martyrs of Compiègne were the 16 members of the Carmel of Compiègne, France: 11 Discalced Carmelite nuns, three lay sisters, and two externs (or tertiaries). They were executed by the guillotine towards the end of the Reign of Terror, at what is now the Place de la Nation in Paris on 17 July 1794, and are venerated as saints in the Catholic Church.

zh.t: 贡比涅16位加尔默罗殉道者遭处决
zh.s: 贡比涅殉道者是法国贡比涅加尔默罗会的16名成员，包括11名赤足加尔默罗会修女、3名在俗修女和2名外部成员（或第三会会士）。他们于1794年7月17日在巴黎现今的民族广场被送上断头台，时间距法国大革命恐怖统治结束仅10天。他们受到天主教会尊为圣人。

en.s: The Capture of Fort Mackinac was one of the first engagements of the War of 1812. A British and Native American force captured the island soon after the outbreak of war between Britain and the United States. Encouraged by the easy British victory, more Native Americans rallied to their support. Their cooperation was an important factor in several British victories during the remainder of the war.

zh.s: 麦基诺堡攻占战是1812年战争初期的交战之一。英军和美洲原住民组成的部队在英美开战后不久攻占了这座岛屿。英军轻易获胜，促使更多美洲原住民加入其阵营。他们的合作成为英国在战争剩余阶段数次获胜的重要因素。

en.s: The Second Battle of Angostura was a military siege and confrontation that took place in the context of the Venezuelan War of Independence between Patriot and Royalist forces, that ended with victory for the Patriots, who managed to capture the city of Angostura on 17 July 1817.

zh.t: 第二次安戈斯图拉战役
zh.s: 第二次安戈斯图拉战役是委内瑞拉独立战争期间爱国军与保皇军之间的一次围城战和交锋。战斗以爱国军获胜告终；他们于1817年7月17日攻占安戈斯图拉城。

en.s: The Battle of Vác, fought between 15 and 17 July 1849, was one of two important battles which took place in Vác during the Hungarian War of Independence. This battle, fought between the Russian Empire's intervention forces led by Field Marshal Ivan Paskevichand and the Hungarian Army of the Upper Danube led by General Artúr Görgei, was part of the Summer Campaign.

zh.s: 瓦茨战役于1849年7月15日至17日进行，是匈牙利独立战争期间在瓦茨发生的两场重要战役之一。交战双方是由伊万·帕斯克维奇元帅率领的俄罗斯帝国干预部队，以及由阿图尔·格尔盖伊将军率领的匈牙利上多瑙河军团。此战是夏季战役的一部分。

en.s: The Battle of Scary Creek was a minor battle fought during the American Civil War across the Kanawha River from present day Nitro in Putnam County, West Virginia on July 17, 1861.

en.s: The Battle of Honey Springs (also known as the Affair at Elk Creek) on July 17, 1863, was an American Civil War engagement. an important victory for Union forces in their efforts to gain control of the Indian Territory. It was the largest confrontation between Union and Confederate forces in the area that would eventually become Oklahoma. The engagement was also unique in the fact that white soldiers were the minority in both fighting forces. African and Native Americans made up significant portions of each of the opposing armies.

zh.s: 霍尼泉战役又称埃尔克溪冲突，于1863年7月17日爆发，是美国内战期间的一场战斗，也是联邦军争夺印第安领地控制权时取得的一次重要胜利。这是后来成为俄克拉荷马州的地区内，联邦军与邦联军之间规模最大的一次交战。此战还有一点特殊之处：交战双方的白人士兵都占少数。非裔美国人和美洲原住民在两支军队中都占有相当比例。

en.t: Harvard School of Dental Medicine is established in Boston, Massachusetts. It is the first dental school in the U.S. that is affiliated with a university
en.s: The Harvard School of Dental Medicine (HSDM) is the dental school of Harvard University. It is located in the Longwood Medical Area in Boston, Massachusetts. In addition to the DMD degree, HSDM offers specialty training programs, advanced training programs, and a PhD program through the Harvard Graduate School of Arts and Sciences. The program considers dentistry a specialty of medicine.

zh.t: 哈佛牙医学院在马萨诸塞州波士顿成立，是美国首所隶属于大学的牙科学校
zh.s: 哈佛牙医学院（HSDM）是哈佛大学的牙科学院，位于马萨诸塞州波士顿的朗伍德医学区。除牙医学博士（DMD）学位外，学院还提供专科培训、高级培训，以及通过哈佛大学文理研究生院开设的博士项目。该项目将牙医学视为医学的一个专科。

en.s: The Battle of Manantiales was fought in southwestern Uruguay as part of the internal conflict between the Blancos and the Colorados that had been going on intermittently since the country's independence. The Blancos, led by Timoteo Aparicio, were leading a rebellion to overthrow the Government of Uruguay, controlled by the Colorados since the end of the Uruguayan War. On 17 July 1871 government General Enrique Castro attacked Aparcio's force.

zh.s: 马南蒂亚莱斯战役发生在乌拉圭西南部，是该国内战的一部分。乌拉圭独立后，布兰科党与科罗拉多党间断交战。蒂莫特奥·阿帕里西奥率领布兰科党人起义，试图推翻自乌拉圭战争结束以来一直由科罗拉多党掌控的政府。1871年7月17日，政府军将领恩里克·卡斯特罗率军进攻阿帕里西奥的部队。

en.s: The Battle of Warbonnet Creek was a skirmish characterized by a duel between "Buffalo Bill" Cody and a young Cheyenne warrior named Heova'ehe or Yellow Hair (often incorrectly translated as "Yellow Hand"). The engagement is often referred to as the First Scalp for Custer because of this incident. It occurred July 17, 1876, in Sioux County in northwestern Nebraska.

zh.s: 沃伯内特溪战役是一场小规模冲突，最为人熟知的是“水牛比尔”科迪与一名年轻夏延族战士之间的单挑。该战士名叫赫奥瓦埃赫，或称黄发（常被误译为“黄手”）。这次交锋也常被称为“为卡斯特取下的第一个头皮”。战斗于1876年7月17日在内布拉斯加州西北部苏县发生。

en.s: The 1878 Invercargill by-election was a by-election during the 6th New Zealand Parliament in the Southland electorate of Invercargill. The by-election occurred following the resignation of MP George Lumsden and was won by Henry Feldwick.

zh.s: 1878年因弗卡吉尔补选是新西兰第六届议会期间南地选区举行的一次补选。时任议员乔治·拉姆斯登辞职后举行补选，亨利·费尔德威克获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Big Dry Wash was fought on July 17, 1882, between troops of the United States Army's 3rd Cavalry Regiment and 6th Cavalry Regiment and warriors of the White Mountain Apache tribe.The location of the battle was called "Big Dry Wash" in Major Evans' official report, but later maps called the location "Big Dry Fork", which is how it is cited in the four Medal of Honor citations that resulted from the battle.

zh.s: 大旱沟战役于1882年7月17日爆发，交战双方是美国陆军第3骑兵团、第6骑兵团和白山阿帕奇族战士。埃文斯少校的官方报告将战场称为“大旱沟”，但后来的地图称其为“大旱叉谷”；这场战斗相关的4份荣誉勋章授勋记录也采用了后一个名称。

en.s: The 1894 New South Wales colonial election was held on 17 July 1894 for all of the 125 seats in the 16th New South Wales Legislative Assembly and it was conducted in single-member constituencies with a first past the post voting system.

zh.s: 新南威尔士殖民地于1894年7月17日举行大选，改选第16届新南威尔士立法议会全部125个席位。选举采用单一议席选区和简单多数制。

en.s: The Battle of Pasjane refers to a series of clashes between Albanian Kachaks under the command of Idriz Seferi and Serbian Chetniks under the command of Rade Radivojević and Dragoljub Nikolić during July 1907 in the villages at the foothills of the Skopska Crna Gora (Karadak) Mountains. The battles ended in a Serbian Chetniks defeat, with almost all of their soldiers falling in battle.

zh.s: 帕斯亚内战役是1907年7月阿尔巴尼亚游击队与塞尔维亚切特尼克部队在一系列村庄发生的冲突。伊德里兹·塞费里指挥阿尔巴尼亚游击队，拉德·拉迪沃耶维奇和德拉戈柳布·尼科利奇指挥塞尔维亚切特尼克部队。战斗在斯科普斯卡黑山（卡拉达克山）山麓村庄展开，最终塞尔维亚切特尼克部队战败，几乎全军阵亡。

en.t: Establishment of International Shooting Sport Federation
en.s: The International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF) is the governing body of Olympic shooting events. It also regulates several non-Olympic shooting sport events. The Federation's activities include regulation of the sport, managing Olympic qualification events and quota places, and organisation of tournaments like the World Cup and World Championships. The ISSF was founded in 17 July 1907 and affiliates more than 150 National Shooting Federations.

zh.t: 国际射击运动联合会成立
zh.s: 国际射击运动联合会（ISSF）是奥运会射击项目的管理机构，也负责管理多项非奥运射击赛事。其工作包括制定项目规则、管理奥运会资格赛和参赛名额，以及举办世界杯和世界锦标赛等赛事。联合会于1907年7月17日成立，目前有150多个国家射击联合会为其成员。

en.s: The Grey by-election of 1913 was a by-election held for Grey during the 18th New Zealand Parliament. As no candidate won an absolute majority on the first ballot on 17 July, a second round was held on 24 July. The seat had become vacant due to the death of Arthur Guinness. Three candidates contested the seat, and it was won by the left-wing candidate, who was elected on the second ballot with Liberal support.

en.s: The Battle of Bazentin Ridge (14–17 July 1916) was part of the Battle of the Somme (1 July – 18 November) on the Western Front in France, during the First World War. On 14 July, the British Fourth Army (General Henry Rawlinson) made a dawn attack against the German 2nd Army (General Fritz von Below) in the Brown Position (Braune Stellung), from Delville Wood westwards to Bazentin le Petit Wood.

zh.s: 巴赞廷山脊战役于1916年7月14日至17日进行，是第一次世界大战西线索姆河战役（7月1日至11月18日）的一部分。7月14日凌晨，亨利·罗林森将军指挥的英国第四集团军向弗里茨·冯·贝洛将军指挥的德国第二集团军发动进攻，攻击范围从德尔维尔森林向西延伸至小巴赞廷森林，目标是德军的“棕色阵地”。

en.t: Tsar Nicholas II of Russia and his immediate family and retainers are executed by Bolshevik Chekists at the Ipatiev House in Yekaterinburg, Russia
en.s: Nicholas II (Nikolai Alexandrovich Romanov; 18 May [O.S. 6 May] 1868 – 17 July 1918) was Emperor of Russia from 1 November 1894 until his abdication in 1917. He was the last Russian monarch before the Russian Revolution and oversaw the Russian Empire's participation in World War I. In 1918, the Romanovs were murdered, putting an end to the Romanov dynasty.

zh.t: 尼古拉二世及其家人和随从在叶卡捷琳堡伊帕季耶夫宅邸遭布尔什维克契卡人员处决
zh.s: 尼古拉二世（尼古拉·亚历山德罗维奇·罗曼诺夫，1868年5月18日〔儒略历5月6日〕—1918年7月17日）于1894年11月1日至1917年退位期间担任俄罗斯皇帝。他是俄罗斯革命前的最后一位君主，统治期间俄罗斯帝国参加了第一次世界大战。1918年，罗曼诺夫家族遭到杀害，罗曼诺夫王朝就此终结。

en.s: The Second Battle of Guilin was fought between the invading Hunan Army, allied to the forces of Chiang Kai-shek, and the forces of the New Guangxi clique personally commanded by Li Zongren. Li was facing a second invasion by the forces of the Yunnan Army (also allied to Chiang Kai-shek) targeted at Nanning. Li was forced to withdraw his forces from Guilin.

zh.s: 第二次桂林战役的交战双方是入侵的湖南军和新桂系部队。湖南军与蒋介石的势力结盟，新桂系部队则由李宗仁亲自指挥。李宗仁还面临云南军的第二次入侵；云南军同样与蒋介石结盟，目标是南宁。李宗仁被迫撤出桂林。

en.s: Altona Bloody Sunday (German: Altonaer Blutsonntag) is the name given to the events of 17 July 1932 when a recruitment march by the Nazi SA led to violent clashes between the police, the SA and supporters of the Communist Party of Germany (KPD) in Altona, which at the time belonged to the Prussian province of Schleswig-Holstein but is now part of Hamburg. Eighteen people were killed.

zh.s: 1932年7月17日，纳粹冲锋队在阿尔托纳举行征募游行，引发警察、冲锋队和德国共产党支持者之间的暴力冲突。这些事件被称为“阿尔托纳血腥星期日”。当时阿尔托纳属于普鲁士石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因省，如今是汉堡的一部分。冲突造成18人死亡。

en.t: Fifth encirclement campaign against the Eyuwan Soviet
en.s: The fifth encirclement campaign against the Eyuwan Soviet was an encirclement campaign launched by the Chinese Nationalist Government against the Eyuwan Soviet, a Communist base in the Hubei–Henan–Anhui border region. It was met by the 25th Red Army's fifth counter-encirclement campaign. As with the fourth campaign, this campaign ended in a Nationalist victory. The 25th Red Army decided in mid-November 1934 to abandon the soviet area and head westwards, joining the Long March.

zh.t: 对鄂豫皖苏区的第五次围剿
zh.s: 对鄂豫皖苏区的第五次围剿是中国国民政府针对鄂豫皖边区共产党根据地发动的一次围剿行动。红25军发起第五次反围剿。与第四次围剿一样，这次行动以国民党获胜告终。1934年11月中旬，红25军决定撤离苏区，向西进军并加入长征。

en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in Brazil on 17 July 1934. Unlike previous elections which had been public, this election was carried out by the Constituent Assembly. The result was a predictable victory for Getúlio Vargas, who received 175 of the 248 votes.

zh.s: 巴西于1934年7月17日举行间接总统选举。与以往公开举行的选举不同，这次选举由制宪会议投票产生总统。结果不出所料，热图利奥·瓦加斯获胜，在248票中得到175票。

en.s: The Spanish coup of July 1936 was a military uprising against the Second Spanish Republic launched on 17–18 July 1936 by a coalition of conservative, monarchist, and far-right officers and civilians. Planned chiefly by Generals Emilio Mola and José Sanjurjo and joined by Francisco Franco, it was intended to overthrow the Popular Front government and replace it with an authoritarian regime.

zh.s: 1936年7月17日至18日，一批保守派、君主派和极右翼军官及平民联合发动军事起义，试图推翻西班牙第二共和国。行动主要由埃米利奥·莫拉和何塞·桑胡尔霍将军策划，弗朗西斯科·佛朗哥也加入其中。政变旨在推翻人民阵线政府，建立威权政权。

en.s: The Spanish Civil War (Spanish: guerra civil española) was fought in Spain from 1936 to 1939 between the Republicans and the Nationalist rebels. Republicans loyal to the left-leaning Popular Front government of the Second Spanish Republic included socialists, anarchists, communists, and separatists, supported by the Soviet Union. The opposing Nationalists were an alliance of Falangists, monarchists, conservatives, traditionalists, syndicalists and fascists, supported by Nazi Germany and Fascist Italy.

zh.s: 西班牙内战于1936年至1939年在西班牙发生，交战双方是共和派与民族主义叛军。共和派忠于倾左的西班牙第二共和国人民阵线政府，包括社会主义者、无政府主义者、共产主义者和分离主义者，并得到苏联支持。对阵的民族主义者由长枪党人、君主派、保守派、传统主义者、工团主义者和法西斯主义者组成联盟，得到纳粹德国和法西斯意大利支持。

en.s: The Kozara Offensive (Serbo-Croatian: Kozaračka ofenziva/ofanziva), also known as Operation West Bosnia (German: Operation West-Bosnien) was a large-scale German-led counter-insurgency operation against the Yugoslav Partisans in the Bosnian mountain region of Kozara in the Independent State of Croatia during World War II. It was launched on 10 June 1942, with the goal to encircle and destroy the Partisans who were operating in the Kozara mountain region near Banja Luka, which threatened German access to the Belgrade-Zagreb railway.

en.s: The Battle of Stalingrad was a major battle on the Eastern Front of World War II in which Nazi Germany and its Axis allies fought the Soviet Union for control of the city of Stalingrad (now Volgograd) in southern Russia. Marked by intense close-quarters combat and heavy civilian losses during aerial bombardment, the battle is considered the largest and deadliest urban battle in military history and the deadliest battle in World War II.

zh.s: 斯大林格勒战役是第二次世界大战东线的一场重要战役，纳粹德国及其轴心国盟友与苏联争夺俄罗斯南部城市斯大林格勒（今伏尔加格勒）的控制权。战斗以激烈的近距离作战和空袭造成的大量平民伤亡为特点，被认为是军事史上规模最大、伤亡最惨重的城市战，也是第二次世界大战中死亡人数最多的战役。

en.s: The Izyum–Barvenkovo offensive (17 July 1943 – 27 July 1943) was a Soviet offensive operation of the Southwestern Front against part of the German Army Group South during World War II. The aim of the operation was to tie down German reserves during the Battle of Kursk and overrun the German forces located in Donbas.

en.s: The Action of 17 July 1944 was a submarine engagement of World War II. It resulted in the sinking of the Japanese Navy's Kadai class submarine I-166 in the Strait of Malacca by the British Royal Navy submarine Telemachus. Operating for the first time with the Eastern Fleet at Colombo in Ceylon, Commander Bill King on 13 July had put himself in a position known as One Fathom bank in order to intercept Japanese traffic between Penang and Singapore. They waited until the 17th when submerged, the ASDIC operator alerted King to the sound of propellers, and the watch soon spotted a Japanese submarine; that being I-166.

zh.s: 1944年7月17日海战是第二次世界大战期间的一场潜艇战。英国皇家海军潜艇泰勒马科斯号在马六甲海峡击沉日本海军海大级潜艇I-166。泰勒马科斯号首次随驻锡兰科伦坡的东方舰队行动时，指挥官比尔·金于7月13日将潜艇部署到一处名为“一浔浅滩”的位置，以拦截槟城与新加坡之间的日本船只。英方一直等到17日。潜艇下潜后，声呐操作员向金报告听到螺旋桨声，值更人员很快发现了日本潜艇I-166。

en.s: The Port Chicago disaster was a deadly munitions explosion that occurred on July 17, 1944, at the Port Chicago Naval Magazine in Port Chicago, California, United States. Munitions detonated while being loaded onto a cargo vessel bound for the Pacific Theater of Operations, killing 320 sailors and civilians and injuring 390 others. Most of the dead and injured were enlisted African-American sailors. A month later, unsafe conditions inspired hundreds of servicemen to refuse to load munitions, an act known as the Port Chicago Mutiny. Fifty men‍—‌called the "Port Chicago 50"‍—‌were convicted of mutiny and sentenced to long prison terms.

zh.s: 1944年7月17日，美国加利福尼亚州波特芝加哥海军军火库发生军火爆炸，造成重大伤亡。当时，军火正装上运往太平洋战区的货船，爆炸造成320名水兵和平民死亡、390人受伤。死伤者大多是非裔美国水兵。一个月后，数百名军人因工作环境不安全而拒绝装载军火，这一行动被称为“波特芝加哥兵变”。其中50人（称为“波特芝加哥50人”）被判兵变罪，并被判处长期监禁。

en.s: Operation Mascot was an unsuccessful British carrier air raid conducted against the German battleship Tirpitz at her anchorage in Kaafjord, Norway, on 17 July 1944. The attack was one of a series of strikes against the battleship launched from aircraft carriers between April and August 1944, and was initiated after Allied intelligence determined that the damage inflicted during the Operation Tungsten raid on 3 April had been repaired. A force of 44 British dive bombers and 40 fighters took off from three aircraft carriers in the early hours of 17 July.

zh.s: 吉祥物行动是英国于1944年7月17日在挪威考峡湾发动的一次航母空袭，目标是停泊在当地的德国战列舰提尔皮茨号，但行动未能奏效。这是1944年4月至8月间针对该舰发动的一系列空袭之一。盟军情报部门确认，4月3日钨行动造成的损伤已修复后，决定发动此次攻击。7月17日凌晨，44架英国俯冲轰炸机和40架战斗机从三艘航空母舰起飞。

en.s: The Second Battle of the Odon comprised operations fought by the British Second Army during the Second World War. Attacks took place in mid-July 1944 against Panzergruppe West, as part of the Battle of Normandy. Operations Greenline and Pomegranate were intended to draw German attention away from Operation Goodwood, an attack from the Orne bridgehead on 18 July.

The participants were the Soviet Union, the United Kingdom, and the United States.

en.s: Operation Kedem was an action planned and carried out by Irgun and Lehi forces in July 1948, during the 1948 Arab–Israeli war. Its purpose was to capture East Jerusalem, including the Old City. en.s: The Battle of Chu-Dreh Pass also known as the Ambush at Chu-Dreh Pass and Operation Myosotis was the last battle of the First Indochina War between French Union and Viet Minh forces that took place on 17 July 1954, in the Central Highlands of French Indochina. It ended with the French battle group, 'Groupement Mobile No. 42' suffering heavy losses and the near destruction of the veteran Corée battalion.

zh.s: 朱德赫山口战役又称朱德赫山口伏击或勿忘我行动，是第一次印度支那战争的最后一场战役，于1954年7月17日在法属印度支那中部高地爆发，交战双方为法兰西联盟军队和越盟部队。法军机动群第42部队损失惨重，法军中久经战阵的“法国营”几乎全军覆没。

en.s: An indirect presidential election (officially the 2nd Federal Convention) was held in West Germany on 17 July 1954. The government parties and the opposition SPD renominated incumbent Theodor Heuss. Against his wishes, the Communist Party of Germany nominated Alfred Weber. Heuss was reelected on the first ballot with about 85% of the vote.

zh.s: 1954年7月17日，西德举行间接总统选举，正式名称为第二届联邦大会。执政党和社民党再次提名现任总统特奥多尔·豪斯。德国共产党不顾豪斯本人的意愿，提名阿尔弗雷德·韦伯。豪斯在首轮投票中以约85%的选票连任。

en.s: General elections were held in the Gold Coast (soon to become Ghana) on 17 July 1956. The result was a victory for Kwame Nkrumah's Convention People's Party, which won 71 of the 104 seats. en.s: The 17 July Revolution (Arabic: انقلاب 17 تموز, romanized: inqilāb 17 Tammūz) was a bloodless coup in Iraq in 1968 led by Ahmed Hassan al-Bakr, Abd ar-Razzaq an-Naif, and Abd ar-Rahman al-Dawud that ousted President Abdul Rahman Arif and Prime Minister Tahir Yahya and brought the Iraqi Regional Branch of the Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party to power.

zh.s: 七一七革命（阿拉伯语：انقلاب 17 تموز，转写：inqilāb 17 Tammūz）是1968年伊拉克发生的一场不流血政变，由艾哈迈德·哈桑·贝克尔、阿卜杜勒·拉扎克·纳伊夫和阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼·达伍德领导。政变推翻总统阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼·阿里夫和总理塔希尔·叶海亚，并使阿拉伯复兴社会党伊拉克地区分支掌权。

zh.s: 圭亚那于1973年7月17日举行大选。人民全国大会党获胜，赢得53个席位中的37席。不过，政府直接控制选举，因此该党胜选被认为是舞弊的结果。投票率为81.0%。

en.s: Mohammad Zahir Shah (15 October 1914 – 23 July 2007) was the last king of Afghanistan, reigning from 8 November 1933 until he was deposed on 17 July 1973. Ruling for almost 40 years, Zahir Shah was the longest-serving ruler of Afghanistan since the foundation of the Durrani Empire in the 18th century. He expanded Afghanistan's diplomatic relations with many countries, including with both sides of the Cold War.

en.s: The 1976 Summer Olympics (French: Jeux olympiques d'été de 1976), officially known as the Games of the XXI Olympiad (Jeux de la XXIe Olympiade) and officially branded as Montreal 1976 (Montréal 1976), were an international multi-sport event held from July 17 to August 1, 1976, in Montreal, Canada. en.s: Sempati Air Flight 304 (SSR304) was a scheduled domestic passenger flight, flying from Husein Sastranegara International Airport in Bandung, West Java to Halim Perdanakusuma Airport in Jakarta. On 17 July 1997, the aircraft operating the flight, a Fokker F27 Friendship 600 leased from Trigana Air Service, registered PK-YPM, crashed into a densely populated neighbourhood of Margahayu in Bandung after suffering an engine failure shortly after take-off killing 28 of the occupants and injuring several on the ground.

zh.t: 森帕蒂航空304号班机空难
zh.s: 森帕蒂航空304号班机（SSR304）是一趟从西爪哇万隆侯赛因·萨斯特拉内加拉国际机场飞往雅加达哈利姆·珀达纳库苏马机场的定期国内客运航班。1997年7月17日，执飞该航线的一架福克F27友谊型600客机（注册号PK-YPM）在起飞后不久发生引擎故障，随后坠入万隆马尔加哈尤人口稠密的居民区。该机为向特里加纳航空服务租赁的飞机。机上28人死亡，地面另有数人受伤。

en.s: The Rome Statute of the International Criminal Court is the treaty that established the International Criminal Court (ICC). It was adopted at a diplomatic conference in Rome, Italy on 17 July 1998 and entered into force on 1 July 2002. As of January 2025, 125 states are party to the statute. Among other things, it establishes court function, jurisdiction and structure.

en.s: A series of bombings took place in Jakarta, Indonesia, on 17 July 2009. en.s: Malaysia Airlines Flight 17 was a scheduled passenger flight from Amsterdam to Kuala Lumpur that was shot down by Russian-backed forces with a Buk 9M38 surface-to-air missile on 17 July 2014, while flying over eastern Ukraine. All 283 passengers and 15 crew were killed.

zh.t: 马来西亚航空17号班机空难
zh.s: 马来西亚航空17号班机是一趟从阿姆斯特丹飞往吉隆坡的定期客运航班。2014年7月17日，飞机在乌克兰东部上空遭到亲俄武装使用一枚布克9M38地对空导弹击落。机上283名乘客和15名机组人员全部遇难。

en.s: Sin Salida (2015) (Spanish for "No Escape"/"No Exit") was a major professional wrestling event produced by the Mexican Lucha Libre-promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) that took place on Friday night July 17, 2015, in CMLL's main venue, Arena México, nicknamed "the cathedral of Lucha Libre" in lieu of CMLL's normally scheduled Super Viernes ("Super Friday") show. The main event was a best two-out-of-three falls Lucha de Apuestas, or bet match where both Rey Escorpión and Último Guerrero "bet" their hair on the outcome of the match and the loser was forced to have all his hair shaved off afterwards as per Lucha Libre traditions.

zh.s: 2015年“无路可逃”（西班牙语：Sin Salida）是墨西哥职业摔角联盟墨西哥世界摔角理事会于2015年7月17日星期五晚间举办的一场大型赛事，取代通常安排的“超级星期五”节目。比赛在该联盟主场墨西哥竞技场举行，该场馆被称为“自由式摔角大教堂”。主赛是一场三局两胜制的赌注赛，蝎王雷伊和终极战士各自以自己的头发作赌注，按照自由式摔角传统，败者赛后必须剃光头发。

en.s: A suicide car bombing occurred on 17 July 2015 in the Iraqi city of Khan Bani Saad, targeting a local marketplace. As of 19 July 2015 approximately 130 people were killed in the bombing, with a similar number of injured. Several people were killed by collapsed buildings. The bomb was hidden under an ice truck in an attempt to attract more people amid the heat. Responsibility for the attack was claimed by the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIL).

zh.s: 2015年7月17日，伊拉克汗巴尼萨阿德市一处当地市场遭遇自杀式汽车炸弹袭击。截至2015年7月19日，爆炸已造成约130人死亡，另有数量相近的人受伤。部分死者被倒塌建筑压死。炸弹藏在一辆冰块运输车内，目的是趁天气炎热吸引更多人群。伊拉克和黎凡特伊斯兰国（ISIL）宣称制造了这起袭击。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in São Tomé and Príncipe on 17 July 2016. Initial results suggested Evaristo Carvalho of Independent Democratic Action had been elected in the first round of voting, defeating incumbent President Manuel Pinto da Costa; however, the results was subsequently annulled, necessitating a second round between Carvalho and Pinto da Costa, which was held on 7 August. However, Pinto da Costa boycotted the second round after claiming the first round had been fraudulent, meaning Carvalho was elected unopposed.

zh.t: 2016年圣多美和普林西比总统选举
zh.s: 圣多美和普林西比于2016年7月17日举行总统选举。初步结果显示，独立民主行动党候选人埃瓦里斯托·卡瓦略在第一轮中击败时任总统曼努埃尔·平托·达科斯塔，当选总统。然而，结果随后被宣布无效，因此两人于8月7日参加第二轮投票。平托·达科斯塔指称首轮选举存在舞弊，抵制第二轮投票，卡瓦略因此在没有对手的情况下当选。

en.s: The 2017 presidential election was held in India on 17 July 2017 with the votes counted and the results announced on 20 July 2017. President Pranab Mukherjee, whose term of office was due to expire on 24 July 2017, declined to seek re-election due to health concerns and old age.

en.s: The 2021 Leinster Senior Hurling Championship final, the deciding game of the 2021 Leinster Senior Hurling Championship, was a hurling match that was played on 17 July 2021 at Croke Park, Dublin. It was contested by Kilkenny and Dublin. Kilkenny, captained by Adrian Mullen, won the game by 1–25 to 0–19. The Dublin team had some withdrawals due to some players being close contacts of a confirmed Covid case.

zh.s: 2021年伦斯特高级板棍球锦标赛决赛是该届赛事的冠军决胜战，于2021年7月17日在都柏林克罗克公园举行，由基尔肯尼队对阵都柏林队。队长阿德里安·穆伦率领基尔肯尼队以1球25分比0球19分获胜。都柏林队有几名球员因与新冠确诊者有过密切接触而退出。

en.s: The 2021 CAF Champions League final was the final match of the 2020–21 CAF Champions League, the 57th season of Africa's premier club football tournament organised by CAF, and the 25th edition under the current CAF Champions League title. It was played at the Stade Mohammed V in Casablanca, Morocco on 17 July 2021. Al Ahly defeated Kaizer Chiefs 3–0 to win a record-extending 10th CAF Champions League title.

zh.s: 2021年非洲足球冠军联赛决赛是2020—21赛季该赛事的冠军决胜战。该赛季是非洲足联主办的非洲顶级俱乐部足球赛事第57个赛季，也是以现名举办的第25届。决赛于2021年7月17日在摩洛哥卡萨布兰卡的穆罕默德五世体育场举行。开罗国民队以3比0击败凯泽酋长队，创纪录地第10次夺冠。

en.s: The 2021 Russian Super Cup was the 19th edition of the Russian Super Cup, an annual football match organised jointly by the Russian Football Union and the Russian Premier League. It was contested by the reigning champions of the Russian Cup and the Russian Premier League. The match featured FC Lokomotiv Moscow, the champions of the 2020–21 Russian Cup, and FC Zenit Saint Petersburg, the winners of the 2020–21 Russian Premier League.

zh.s: 2021年俄罗斯超级杯是第19届俄罗斯超级杯，这项年度足球赛事由俄罗斯足球联盟和俄罗斯足球超级联赛共同主办。参赛双方为俄罗斯杯和俄罗斯足球超级联赛的卫冕冠军。本场比赛由2020—21赛季俄罗斯杯冠军莫斯科火车头队对阵同期俄超冠军圣彼得堡泽尼特队。

en.s: The 2021 Polish Super Cup was the 30th Polish Super Cup, an annual Polish football match played between the reigning winners of the Ekstraklasa and Polish Cup. The Ekstraklasa champions Legia Warsaw faced Polish Cup winners Raków Częstochowa. Raków played their first ever Super Cup match, while Legia was playing to win their fifth Super Cup. Cracovia were the defending champions, but failed to qualify to the match indicated.

zh.s: 2021年波兰超级杯是第30届波兰超级杯，由当季波兰足球甲级联赛和波兰杯的卫冕冠军交锋。波兰足球甲级联赛冠军华沙莱吉亚队对阵波兰杯冠军琴斯托霍瓦队。这是琴斯托霍瓦队首次参加超级杯，华沙莱吉亚队则力争第五次夺冠。卫冕冠军克拉科维亚队未能获得本场比赛参赛资格。

en.s: The 2021 Bulgarian Supercup was the 18th edition of the Bulgarian Supercup, an annual football match played between the winners of the previous season's First League and the Bulgarian Cup. The game was played between the champions of the 2020–21 First League, Ludogorets Razgrad, and the 2020–21 Bulgarian Cup winners, CSKA Sofia. This was Ludogorets's 9th Bulgarian Supercup appearance and CSKA Sofia's 6th.

zh.s: 2021年保加利亚超级杯是第18届保加利亚超级杯，这项年度足球赛事由上赛季保加利亚足球甲级联赛和保加利亚杯冠军交锋。参赛双方为2020—21赛季甲级联赛冠军卢多戈雷茨队和同期保加利亚杯冠军索菲亚中央陆军队。这是卢多戈雷茨队第9次、索菲亚中央陆军队第6次参加超级杯。

en.s: The 2022 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship final was a hurling match played at Croke Park in Dublin on 17 July 2022 between Kilkenny and Limerick, the culmination of the 2022 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship. It was the 135th final of that sport's primary competition, the All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship. This was the earliest in the year that the final had ever taken place.

en.s: By-elections were held in Punjab, Pakistan on 17 July 2022 to elect 20 members of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab. zh.s: 巴基斯坦旁遮普省于2022年7月17日举行补选，选出省议会的20名议员。巴基斯坦正义运动党在20席中赢得15席，取得压倒性胜利。选举后，首席部长哈姆扎·沙赫巴兹领导的巴基斯坦穆斯林联盟（谢里夫派）联合政府垮台，在议会中距多数席位还差7席。
